convite.descricao: Pick a connector type to create your first line. The trial is one per installation and lasts 3 days.

ZAPI.descricao: Connects by scanning a QR code on your phone. Fastest to get started.

formulario.descricao: We use these details to reach you during the trial. Review and correct them if needed.

phone.erro: Enter a valid phone number, including the area code.

ativado: Trial activated. Your line was created.
emAndamentoDescricao: Your trial runs until {{data}}. After that the line stays visible but stops sending and receiving messages.

indisponivelDescricao: The trial plan is not configured in this environment. Contact support to enable it.
